comments.text:
Maimuna Ali
★ LAW200, TTR
TEACHING: teaches very well, explains everything very simply with examples. explains the case laws in an easy to remember way but you need some effort to understand the whole thing and to remember the sections.
GRADING:
- QUIZ (15 marks) she takes 2 quizzes, counts best 1. if you do well in quiz 1 or satisfied with your marks she allows you to skip quiz 2. 10 MCQs and 2 short questions.
- MID (30 marks): only has problem questions and essay questions. for problem questions you need to follow the IRAC writing method, she gives suggestions for problem questions and questions come from the suggestions. for essay questions she'll give a more general idea but you need to have a good grasp of the overall syllabus.
you can EASILY get full marks in quizzes and mid as she's pretty generous with marking.
- PRESENTATION (10 marks): she will assign the topic to each group. 5 marks for group cohesiveness, slides, group’s overall alignment and 5 marks for individual speeches. she doesn't ask questions after presentation, only gives a review about slides and content. she mostly looks at how much research you've done about your assigned topic.
- ATTENDANCE(10 marks): can miss up to 3 classes and she might consider more if you have an actual valid reason.
- FINALS (40 marks): MCQs, Problem Questions and Essay Questions.
EXTRA: her classes maybe a little long at times and she uses notes instead of slides so it may seem like there's a lot of content but when you actually study you'll realize it's really not much at all. she only keeps the basics, very streamlined outline. she makes the course very easy for everyone and is an excellent teacher. you'll get through the course very smoothly with a very good grade if you get her.

Maimuna Ali sir counts the best one quiz out two which contains 20 marks. Mid is 30 and final is 40. There is no presentation, no report, no assignments. Attendance is very important, he counts all the classes but if you miss any class then you can visit his office and explain your reasons. Also he is very punctual, he doesn't like students who are late in the class.
He teaches well. The course is very very very basic. Mane etoi easiest jinish je i used to feel dumb that eshob ki course
Like yeah there is a few things which are new and interesting but nothing rocket science. So classes will be lil bit boring and all.
Also sir provides handouts for quizzes,mid and final. He will give you a pattern which you can follow in the exams.
One thing that is super important for him is " CLASS PARTICIPATION "
He should know your name in a good way, he should see your face during classes. Make sure that you ask questions and talk to him during class. Or else he will decurve.
I'd recommend him 100/100 fr. One of the most easygoing course that I've done in NSU so far hands down
